# Advisories the dependency audit is allowed to pass with. Read by
# scripts/ci/npm_audit.py.
#
# Target: zero. Every line here needs the founder's approval, a reason and a
# review date. An exception covers exactly one advisory: any other high or
# critical advisory still fails the job, in dev dependencies too (the full
# audit never runs with --omit=dev).
#
# An exception is only for an advisory in dev dependencies (founder,
# 2026-10-05). It is keyed by advisory id, not by how the package is reached,
# so the job also reads `npm audit --omit=dev`: if an advisory listed here
# appears in that runtime report, its dev-only premise no longer holds and the
# job fails, whatever the line's date. Fix the runtime dependency; the line
# can't be used to pass it.
#
# Format:  <suite> <advisory id> review=<YYYY-MM-DD>  # reason
#   suite = web
#
# An exception ends on its review date (founder, 2026-10-05). The job warns
# on every run for the 7 days before it. From the date itself the advisory
# fails the job again, until the line is removed (a fix exists) or given a
# new date and reason.
# A line whose advisory is no longer reported is announced as stale; delete it.
